t: Now, I have come out of my city either as an oppressor or as the oppressed, either as a rebel or one against whom rebelion has been committed. In any case, to whomsoever this letter of mine reaches, I appeal to him in the mame of Allah that he should come to me and if I am in the right he should help me; but if I am in the wrong then he should try to get me to the right according to his view.
